The Rheem PROE50-T2-RH-CG is a 50 gallon residential electric tank water heater from the Professional Classic line in a tall configuration, used for whole-home hot water in replacement and new construction. It is rated 4.5 kW at 240 V, with a first hour rating of 63 gallons and a Uniform Energy Factor (UEF) of 0.92. The glass-lined steel tank is 58-1/2" high and 20-1/4" in diameter with 3/4" water connections. It is demand response ready, with a built-in EcoPort (CTA-2045 port) for connection to utility demand response programs.

Key Features

  • 50 gallon tank with a first hour rating of 63 gallons
  • 4.5 kW at 240 V
  • Uniform Energy Factor (UEF) of 0.92
  • Tall configuration: 58-1/2" high and 20-1/4" in diameter
  • Demand response ready with a built-in EcoPort (CTA-2045 port)
  • Glass-lined steel tank with 3/4" water connections

Applications

  • Replacing an existing 50 gallon 240 V electric tank water heater
  • Residential new construction with a 240 V water heater circuit
  • Closets and utility spaces where floor area is limited and a 20-1/4" diameter tank fits
  • Homes whose peak-hour hot water use fits a first hour rating of 63 gallons

Before You Order

  • Power source: electric only, 240 V. No gas or vent connection is used.
  • Electrical supply: 4.5 kW at 240 V. Confirm the circuit, breaker and wire size against the rating plate and local electrical code.
  • Dimensions: the tank is 58-1/2" high and 20-1/4" in diameter. Allow room above for the water connections and check the path to the installation spot.
  • Connections: 3/4" water connections.
  • Demand response: programs and connection hardware vary by utility. Check with your utility before relying on it.
  • Local code: check the requirements for the T&P relief discharge line, drain pan, thermal expansion tank and seismic strapping.
